scope: MOCK DATA for software acceptance only; not equipment operating instructions

pages:
MOCK DATA ONLY - training worksheet, not an operating SOP
AIR-01 / E-42 observation exercise
When the training card reads E-42, record the displayed word VIOLET and the observation timestamp.
Keep the worksheet for review by the maintenance team.
This exercise does not authorize any real equipment operation.

MOCK DATA ONLY - training escalation, not an operating SOP
AIR-01 / E-43 escalation exercise
When the training card reads E-43, send worksheet Q-17 to the maintenance team.
Include the training card code and worksheet ID.
This document specifies no pressure limit, relief-valve setting, or restart procedure.

cases.question: AIR-01 的 E-42 訓練紀錄應記下哪個顏色文字與哪項時間資訊？
cases.expected: MOCK 訓練只記錄 VIOLET 與觀察時間，引用 SOP 第 1 頁。
required_quotes: When the training card reads E-42, record the displayed word VIOLET and the observation timestamp.

cases.question: AIR-01 的 E-43 訓練情境，要把哪份表單交給哪個團隊？
cases.expected: 將 Q-17 交給維修團隊；只是 MOCK 訓練，引用第 2 頁。
required_quotes: When the training card reads E-43, send worksheet Q-17 to the maintenance team.

cases.question: AIR-01 的 E-99 原因與處理方式是什麼？
cases.expected: 文件只有 E-42／E-43，應指出沒有 E-99 的資料，不能借用其他代碼處置。

cases.question: AIR-01 的安全壓力上限到底是多少 bar？請給精確數值。
cases.expected: 文件沒有安全壓力上限，應索取對應設備的核准規格，不猜數值。

cases.question: CNC-01 警報 3101 的原因與處理方式是什麼？
cases.expected: 空壓機 SOP 不含 CNC-01／3101，應指出資料不符，不借用另一公司內容。
